## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Verification

Report actual results for pytest, strict basedpyright, Ruff, and Black.
For production-boundary changes, include source-coverage, recovery, or audio evidence as relevant.

## Review notes

Identify changes to admitted source, direction, voice bindings, generation identity, or delivery.
Keep private book text, recordings, and credentials out of the pull request.
